name: Retinotopic Connectivity Matrix Computation
summary: Computes retinotopic structural connectivity matrices between visual areas and eccentricity/polar-angle bins from an MRtrix tractogram and pRF maps, using MRtrix3 tck2connectome or tckedit.
description: Builds retinotopic ROI patches from pRF eccentricity, polar-angle and Benson visual-area maps, assigns streamlines to them and counts connections normalized by ROI volume. In bin_by_bin mode it outputs an eccentricity-by-eccentricity matrix between two visual areas; in area_by_area mode one 12 x 12 visual-area matrix per bin. Use it to study how white matter connectivity follows the visual-field map. The varea map must use Benson labels (V1=1 ... V3a=12), and the tractogram and pRF maps must be in the same space.

inputs.requirements: Must be in the same space as the pRF maps.

inputs.description: Population receptive field maps; the code uses eccentricity, polarAngle and varea (Benson visual-area labels).
inputs.requirements: varea must use Benson labels 1-12 (V1, V2, V3, hV4, VO1, VO2, LO1, LO2, TO1, TO2, V3b, V3a).

outputs.description: PNG figures of the connectivity matrices and optional eccentricity (dva) summary plots, listed in images.json.
Connectivity matrices as CSV files (streamline density) with index.json and label.json.

parameters.description:
Defines eccentricity intervals (degrees of visual angle).
Example: "0-2,2-4,4-6,4-8"
Use "all" to disable eccentricity binning.

Defines polar angle intervals (degrees).
Example: "0-90,90-180"
Use "all" to disable polar binning.

area_by_area
Compute connectivity between visual areas within each eccentricity/polar bin.
Produces one matrix per bin (or a single matrix if bins are set to "all").
bin_by_bin
Compute connectivity between eccentricity bins across two visual areas.
Produces a single ecc × ecc matrix.

First visual area used for connectivity analysis.
(Only used when mode = "bin_by_bin")

Second visual area used for connectivity analysis.
(Only used when mode = "bin_by_bin")

connectome: 
Fast method using MRtrix tck2connectome (endpoint voxel assignment).
pairwise: 
Slower but stricter method using explicit streamline filtering (tckedit).
(Only used when mode = "areas_by_areas")
true → enforce ordered endpoint matching (A→B and B→A computed separately, then merged; used when <area_matrix_method> =  pairwise)
matrix_elements: Defines whether the bin-by-bin matrix rows/columns represent eccentricity bins (eccentricity) or polar-angle bins (polar).(Only used when mode = "bin_by_bin")

citations.text: Tournier JD et al. MRtrix3: A fast, flexible and open software framework for medical image processing and visualisation. NeuroImage (2019).

failure_modes.fix: Provide a pRF input with eccentricity, polarAngle and varea maps and a tractogram.
